history.new: Novel only in the case 'common border without containment'. The case with no common border (c = 1) follows from R. D. Gray, B. Steinberg, Forum Math. Sigma 14 (2026) e58, Thm 8.1 (https://doi.org/10.1017/fms.2026.10209) with Anick's strong freeness, and for different first/last letters from M. Albenque, P. Nadeau, FPSAC 2009 Cor. 3 + Adjan (CLM-C01-09); the containment case is Kurth 1987 (CLM-C01-06). The homological counterpart of the common-border dichotomy is Gray-Steinberg, Selecta Math. 28 (2022) art. 59, Thm B (https://doi.org/10.1007/s00029-022-00773-3). Searched without finding the growth formula: Anick, Piontkovski, Iyudu-Shkarin, Ufnarovski, Cain-Gray-Malheiro, Nyberg-Brodda survey, Rigo, OEIS (Historian audit).
history.old: Two web searches (2026-10-18) found no general formula; related literature - Nyberg-Brodda survey of one-relation monoids (arXiv:2105.02853), "Relations on words" (arXiv:1602.03364), Kudryavtseva 2010. Needs a deeper search (Hilbert series of one-relator algebras - Anick, Piontkovski, Iyudu).

statement:
For all words u != v of equal length k over a q-letter alphabet, the number of congruence classes of
length-n words modulo u = v has generating function c(x) / (x^k + (1 - q x) c(x)), where
c(x) = 1 + sum over words b that are borders of both u and v of x^(k - |b|).
title: Common-border conjecture: one-relation class counts depend only on common borders
